description: This file implements a COCO evaluator class for object detection, segmentation, and keypoints, supporting distributed processing. It includes methods for preparing results, evaluating, and summarizing metrics, and interacts with pycocotools for COCO dataset evaluation.

classes.name: CocoEvaluator
classes.description: Class for evaluating object detection, segmentation, and keypoints using COCO metrics in distributed mode.

methods.name: convert_to_xywh
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from corner coordinates to (x, y, width, height) format.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges evaluation results from multiple processes.

methods.name: create_common_coco_eval
methods.description: Creates a common COCO evaluation object from merged results.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runs per-image evaluation and stores results.
